title: 3D 邏輯堆疊熱管理
summary: 以四階段、24 步深入3D 邏輯堆疊熱阻、熱點重疊及工作負載；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine 3d logic thermal resistance, hotspot overlap and workloads. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。熱阻網路是降階近似；3D 堆疊中的空間耦合、溫度相依漏電與瞬態工作負載需要校準模型。
scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Thermal networks are reduced approximations; spatial coupling, temperature-dependent leakage and transient workloads require calibration.

stages.title: 三維熱路
stages.description: 本階段處理三維熱路：依序完成三個技術單元的模型與獨立驗證，將物理主張連到可觀察資料。
stages.descriptionEn: Address three-dimensional heat paths through three technical units, each with a model and independent verification linking physical claims to observable evidence.

steps.title: 標出每層熱源
steps.titleEn: Map layer heat sources
steps.objective: 建立「標出每層熱源」的可檢驗工程模型，說明：不同功能區的功率密度不均，不能以整片平均代表局部峰值。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable engineering model for map layer heat sources: Functional regions have unequal power density; averages hide peaks.
steps.instruction: 先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。建立各層位置相對應的功率圖。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. Build registered power maps for all layers. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：建立各層位置相對應的功率圖。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Build registered power maps for all layers. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：各層溫升都只用自己的功率乘同一熱阻。本步先檢查「標出每層熱源」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到不同功能區的功率密度不均，不能以整片平均代表局部峰值。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Each layer rises only by its own power times the same resistance. First check whether evidence for map layer heat sources actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Functional regions have unequal power density; averages hide peaks.
steps.check: 交付「標出每層熱源」模型與比較圖，至少包含本步指定的操作、預測方向、量測單位及未驗證假設。
steps.checkEn: Submit the model and comparison for map layer heat sources, including the specified action, predicted direction, units and an unvalidated assumption.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「3D 邏輯堆疊熱管理」的「標出每層熱源」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出晶粒、基板、接點與量測端的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「熱島救援：模組交付前夜」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與批號、接合位置、熱歷史、接點讀值與顯微圖版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Map layer heat sources” in “Thermal management for 3D logic stacks”. Draw the die, substrate, joint and measurement interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Thermal Island: Before Module Delivery” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for lot, joint location, thermal history, contact readings and micrograph version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

steps.title: 連接串並聯熱阻
steps.titleEn: Connect thermal resistances
steps.objective: 建立「連接串並聯熱阻」的可檢驗工程模型，說明：上層熱路可能承載下層累積功率，不能逐層孤立計算。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable engineering model for connect thermal resistances: Upper paths may carry accumulated lower-layer power.
steps.instruction:
先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。驗算上層 8 K、下層 14 K 的例。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。

假設兩層熱源各 20 W，上層到冷端 R1=0.2 K/W，下層到上層 R2=0.3 K/W，且僅向上散熱：上層升溫 (20+20)R1=8 K，下層再升 20R2=6 K，共 14 K。
steps.instructionEn:
Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. Check the 8 K upper and 14 K lower example. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.

Assume two layers at 20 W each, upper-to-sink R1=0.2 K/W, lower-to-upper R2=0.3 K/W and upward-only flow. Upper rise is 8 K; lower adds 6 K for 14 K total.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：驗算上層 8 K、下層 14 K 的例。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Check the 8 K upper and 14 K lower example. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：各層溫升都只用自己的功率乘同一熱阻。本步先檢查「連接串並聯熱阻」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到上層熱路可能承載下層累積功率，不能逐層孤立計算。所指出的物理限制。

沿用上一步模型，但先寫下什麼結果會推翻它。驗算上層 8 K、下層 14 K 的例。 加入一組對照或重複量測，改變一個會造成混淆的條件，將觀察分為支持、矛盾及仍不足。若只有模擬資料，清楚標成模擬，並指定下一項實物驗證。

假設兩層熱源各 20 W，上層到冷端 R1=0.2 K/W，下層到上層 R2=0.3 K/W，且僅向上散熱：上層升溫 (20+20)R1=8 K，下層再升 20R2=6 K，共 14 K。
steps.instructionEn:
Use the previous model, first specifying what result would refute it. Check the 8 K upper and 14 K lower example. Add a control or repeated measurement, vary one confounder, and classify observations as supporting, conflicting or insufficient. Label simulated data explicitly and specify the next physical validation.

Assume two layers at 20 W each, upper-to-sink R1=0.2 K/W, lower-to-upper R2=0.3 K/W and upward-only flow. Upper rise is 8 K; lower adds 6 K for 14 K total.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：驗算上層 8 K、下層 14 K 的例。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Check the 8 K upper and 14 K lower example. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：熱 TSV 越多對所有功能必定越好。本步先檢查「連接串並聯熱阻」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到上層熱路可能承載下層累積功率，不能逐層孤立計算。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: More thermal TSVs always improve every function. First check whether evidence for connect thermal resistances actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Upper paths may carry accumulated lower-layer power.
steps.check: 交付「連接串並聯熱阻」的驗收紀錄：包含指定觀察、誤差來源、能支持的結論與一項應暫緩放行的結果。
steps.checkEn: Submit acceptance evidence for connect thermal resistances: the specified observation, error sources, supported conclusion and one hold condition.

knowledge.text: 驗算上層 8 K、下層 14 K 的例。 記錄原始觀察和推論之間的區別。
knowledge.textEn: Check the 8 K upper and 14 K lower example. Keep raw observations distinct from inference.

knowledge.title: 自訂算例與模型界限
knowledge.titleEn: Hypothetical worked example and model boundary
knowledge.text: 假設兩層熱源各 20 W，上層到冷端 R1=0.2 K/W，下層到上層 R2=0.3 K/W，且僅向上散熱：上層升溫 (20+20)R1=8 K，下層再升 20R2=6 K，共 14 K。 熱阻網路是降階近似；3D 堆疊中的空間耦合、溫度相依漏電與瞬態工作負載需要校準模型。
knowledge.textEn: Assume two layers at 20 W each, upper-to-sink R1=0.2 K/W, lower-to-upper R2=0.3 K/W and upward-only flow. Upper rise is 8 K; lower adds 6 K for 14 K total. Thermal networks are reduced approximations; spatial coupling, temperature-dependent leakage and transient workloads require calibration.

quiz.questionEn: Which approach or claim is physically justified for connect thermal resistances: challenge and acceptance?

optionsEn: Check the 8 K upper and 14 K lower example.
Each layer rises only by its own power times the same resistance
More thermal TSVs always improve every function
